success: Action success AND truth endpoint <=0.15m/0.20rad AND >=5m AND no conservative-envelope overlap AND sufficient scan/truth samples AND requested obstacle inserted
distance: world truth integral minus mean successful no-obstacle integral for the same profile; unavailable if no successful reference
time: simulated action duration; excludes post-action settling
smoothness: TV of bridge commanded steering atan(0.28*omega/v) when abs(v)>.005m/s, otherwise0, divided by truth distance; command proxy, not steering-joint measurement
safety: Known world-box geometry against conservative body/wheel envelope sampled from ModelStates; not contact-sensor certification
randomization: Gazebo seeds recorded; AMCL scheduling and random sampling are not bitwise deterministic
means: Time, detour, smoothness and endpoint means use qualified successes only. All failures remain in denominator and CSV. Negative distance differences are retained, including run-to-run path/localization variation.
comparison: Same physical goal, map, control libraries and external .15m/.20rad validator. Internal stop tolerance is an explicit tuning variable; current B_tuned is .02m, historical A/B/intermediate profiles .05m. Each profile uses a matching static reference.
